items.title: Kjeden skal åpne en rekke steder i byen. Nå avslører de når den første restauranten åpner

items.excerpt: Ta ein ekstra titt på Wales-spelarane før det viktige Nasjonsliga-oppgjeret mot Noreg laurdag. No avslører ei av stjernene sanninga bak tradisjonen.

items.title: Trump, Putin and Xi plan historic joint meeting in China next week, White House says
items.excerpt: Trump will discuss the "reduction of nuclear weapons" during the unprecedented talks, a spokeswoman says.

items.title: Chelsea go top with 1-0 win against Man City
items.excerpt: Chelsea return to the top of the Women's Super League with a crucial victory over rivals Manchester City who went down to 10 players in the second half.

items.title: Nigeria cautions against travel via Ethiopia's main airport due to altitude
items.excerpt: The foreign ministry in Abuja says 6 Nigerians with underlying health problems have died this year while transiting through Addis Ababa.

items.title: Werner Holzer Prize awarded to Katja Gloger and DW's Jaafar Abdul Karim
items.excerpt: DW journalist Jaafar Abdul Karim and Russia correspondent Katja Gloger have been awarded the prestigious Werner Holzer Prize for international journalism.

items.title: US has floated Ukraine ceding Donbas for Nato membership, Zelensky says
